; REQ: LANG-2631 LANG-2632 LANG-2633 LANG-2634
; Greeter
Structure Person
  Name.s
  Age.i
EndStructure
Procedure.s Greet(*p.Person, Times = 1)
  Protected Text.s = ~"Hello, " + *p\Name + ~"!\n"
  For i = 1 To Times
    Debug Text
  Next
  ProcedureReturn Text
EndProcedure
Define ann.Person : ann\Name = "Ann"
If Len(Greet(@ann, 2)) > 0 And #True : Debug $1F : EndIf
